data.title: Timeline and calendar are reports in the catalogue, text, --json and --html; no TUI view yet
data.why: The agent and the person ask the same command, and the catalogue already carries --json, a self-contained SVG page and a perf case per report. A TUI Gantt is terminal-boundary code, where four bugs shipped past a green suite.
data.rejected: A kadence ui screen first: the hardest surface to verify, for the same numbers
